findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_removal_guide · Private data: scan_domain, get_service_info · Public sink: list_vendors.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_removal_guide · Private data: scan_domain, get_service_info · Public sink: list_vendors

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
